name: NVIDIA cuBLAS for CUDA 12 (CUDA 12.8.1 redistributable)
purpose: Runtime for CTranslate2 (faster-whisper) GPU inference; PyTorch keeps its own CUDA 13 cuBLAS.
license: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit EULA (Attachment A lists cublas.dll and cublasLt.dll as distributable)
download_url_note: Not used by default; only with -AllowDownload. The archive and the extracted DLLs must still match the hashes below.
bundle_destination_note: ctranslate2/__init__.py adds its own package folder to the DLL search path, so no global search path is needed.
notes: The two DLLs in this archive carry no Authenticode signature; provenance rests on the HTTPS download and the SHA-256 published in the NVIDIA manifest.
cuDNN for CUDA 12 is deliberately not bundled: CTranslate2 4.8.1 does not reference it, and cudnn64_9.dll would collide with PyTorch's CUDA 13 cuDNN of the same name.
